sample_unit: prompts (13 orthodontic questions plus one rephrasing each), submitted to five models

links.outcome: Consistency of chatbot response ratings between original and rephrased orthodontic questions
links.effect: Consistency varied by model: Gemini 92%, ChatGPT-4 54%, Bing Copilot 46%, ChatGPT-3.5 23%. Only LLaMA and Gemini showed high consistency.
links.quote: GenAI chatbots provide generally accurate orthodontic information, but performance depends on question phrasing.

links.outcome: Readability of chatbot responses to patient orthodontic questions (Flesch Reading Ease)
links.effect: All five models produced responses with low readability, with Flesch scores of 45-49.
links.quote: All models produced responses with low readability (Flesch scores 45-49).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the performance, accuracy, readability, and consistency across rephrased prompts of five commercial LLM chatbots for orthodontic patient queries, but does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
